observed_contract.revocation_mechanism: user_store.bump_token_version() on logout; token ver compared to persisted user
observed_contract.admin_authority_source: Persisted user context / designated admin policy; client-supplied role/MFA headers not authoritative
observed_contract.device_activity: login_activity records browser/device provenance but is not proof of device cryptographic binding
observed_contract.credential_write_guard: Admin role + owner/revision CAS + encrypted synthetic vault write + audit transaction; no step-up proof observed

requirements.description: Approved authenticator enrollment, recovery flow, replay denial and independent security review
Server-validated fresh MFA assertion with action/subject/resource bound nonce, TTL and audit before sensitive credentials operation
Server-issued opaque per-device session identifier, explicit consent, expiry, device inventory and revoke one/all semantics
Per-device refresh invalidation + revocation propagation/reuse-detection tests on disposable fixtures
Step-up challenge/use/expiry/device revocation deny-path event receipts, redacted and independently verified

disallowed_interpretation: Remember-this-device extends refresh TTL but does not establish cryptographically device-bound MFA, step-up or independent operator acceptance
